name: Godrej Consumer Products

figures.source: Screener.in (consolidated P&L) — annual Sales line; organised sector; includes non-BPC lines (household insecticides)
india.json shares — share of summed revenue for the 3 listed IN brand owners (base INR 82,038cr); flagged non_pure_play. NOT a market share

read: The second listed Indian incumbent, Rs15,178cr FY26 at 21% operating margin — roughly a quarter of HUL's scale on a near-identical margin structure, which is the useful observation: 20-22% is the incumbent cost structure in Indian BPC regardless of size, and any entrant modelling Indian unit economics should treat that band as the mature-state benchmark rather than an outlier. Growth has been lumpy (Rs14,096cr FY24, Rs13,997cr FY25, Rs15,178cr FY26). companies.yaml records no segment split for Godrej and no BPC-only revenue line exists in this repo, so its position within specific segments is not evidenced here.
